carry_over_inherited: (1) THE SENDMESSAGE RESUME PATH RETURNS NO USAGE BLOCK. Resuming an agent is the prompt's own prescribed recovery from a usage-limit termination, and it is also the right way to hand measured data to a running build - but the hand-back it returns carries no subagent_tokens, tool_uses or duration_ms, so the prompt's verbatim-accounting requirement cannot be met for any resumed round. Tonight that silently lost the two largest rounds of the night. (2) A COORDINATOR CAN LAUNDER AN AGENT'S NUMBER INTO ITS OWN CROSS-CHECK. Tonight the coordinator quoted 'nine cells' back to the agent as a finding; it was the agent's own pre-correction number and it was wrong. The rule that follows: a coordinator may only state a figure in a correction directive if it computed that figure itself in this session, and should say which. (3) A SINGLE FLOOR MEASUREMENT AT THE START OF A CAMPAIGN IS NOT ENOUGH ON A SHARED BOARD. Measuring the floor once, first, under the highest foreign load of the session, falsified a bound and put the entire scatter of one baseline into one confound. Measure it at the start AND the end at minimum, and interleave the grid. (4) 60 SECONDS OF DRY RUN BOUGHT A CLEAN 27-MINUTE CAMPAIGN. Three of the last four hardware campaigns in this mission were discarded for instrumentation defects; this one was not, and the only difference was a dry run that asserted every output file existed with rows before the real campaign launched. Keep it.
